shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && rg -n \"onError|createChatOrchestrator|rejection\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md | head -160 && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,430p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,80p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,45p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec anchor|validated by|spec:\" src/orchestration src | head -100 && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\" && sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,160p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.build.json && rg -n \"new Error\\(.*cause|cause:\" src | head -40"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): report non-error rejections" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && test "$(git rev-list --count origin/loop-bench/95..HEAD)" -eq 0 && test "$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/loop-bench/95)" -eq 0 && git log -1 --oneline'
